title: Coverage available from the fund; deductible.
bodyText: Coverage limits and deductibles for policies issued by the fund covering eligible property shall be established in the plan of operation, subject to approval by the commissioner.
bodyHtml: §431P-10  Coverage available from the fund; deductible.  Coverage limits and deductibles for policies issued by the fund covering eligible property shall be established in the plan of operation, subject to approval by the commissioner. [L 1993, c 339, pt of §2; am L Sp 1995, c 17, §5; am L 2000, c 153, §1; am L 2016, c 141, §14; am L 2025, c 296, §14]
